tasks.name: Complete onboarding
acceptance_criteria: Required access checked and brief accepted

tasks.name: Confirm the delivery brief
tasks.description: Draft outcome, scope, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and approval responsibilities.

tasks.name: Verify required account access
tasks.description: Identify required accounts from the agreed brief and verify role-based access. Do not collect passwords.
acceptance_criteria: Required permissions tested and gaps recorded

tasks.name: Accept onboarding readiness
tasks.description: Check the accepted brief and verified access before the next delivery phase.
acceptance_criteria: Sponsor accepts readiness or explicitly approves documented exceptions
